newsitem.title: POLAND: Mostostal G eyes acquisitions in H2.
newsitem.headline: Mostostal G eyes acquisitions in H2.

text.p: The Polish construction company Mostostal Gdansk SA wants to use 70 percent of funds raised through its new, 1.4 million share issue, to buy several construction firms, Mostostal's spokesman said on Monday.
Ireneusz Dobber told Reuters the acquisitions were likely to take part in the second half of this year, but declined to give any names.
"The company earmarked 70 percent of the 20 million zlotys expected from the new issue for capital acqusitions, 20 percent for turnover capital and 10 percent for machinery purchases," Dobber said.

He said the company was receiving many offers for the new shares from foreign investors, some of which concerned the purchase of the whole issue, which would represent a 35 percent stake in the firm after the capital rise.
Currently Mostostal Gdansk has 2.6 million shares outstanding.
But Dobber said the management was unlikely to allot the issue to a foreign buyer.
"We are very pleased with the interest in our company from abroad, but it is unlikely that a substantial part of this issue would be sold alloted to a foreign investor," he said.
